title: FAQs
lead: Short answers to what people ask most. Anything else, a person is a call away.
a1: Every pouch is ground and packed in small batches in {city} and carries its packing date and batch code. Best before is 12 months from packing.
a2: The blends are built for warmth and aroma, not heat. The heat in most dishes comes from chilli, so Guntur Chilli Powder is sold on its own.
a3: No colour, no filler and no anti-caking agent. Single spices are one ingredient; blends list every spice on the label.
a4: Orders ship within 48 hours. Most cities receive them two to five working days after dispatch.
q5: Can I pay cash on delivery?
a5: Yes. Cash on delivery carries a small handling fee and an order limit, both shown at checkout before you pay.
q6: Do I get a GST invoice?
a6: Yes, on every order. It is emailed with your order confirmation and can be downloaded from your account.
a7: Tell us within 48 hours with a photo of the pouch and its batch code. We replace or refund it; you do not need to send it back.
a8: Yes. {shop} supplies retail and distribution partners across India. Write to us with what you need.
